messages:
Riley: Noting a p95 mismatch between the service-level and endpoint panel for /v1/classify. Service shows p95=85ms, endpoint panel shows p95=180ms.
Marta: Seen it. p50s align. This smells like different aggregation semantics (histogram vs tdigest).
Devon: We rolled in histogram-rollup for endpoints to reduce cardinality last week (PR 9011). Histograms are 20ms buckets which can badly bump p95 for sparse tails.
Riley: Can someone run a raw-sample single-tdigest p95 across the service? Need ground truth.
Devon: Quick run: single-tdigest service p95=88ms. Per-host raw p95: host1=86ms host2=90ms.
Marta: So dashboard endpoint 180ms is wrong. Likely merge_histogram with coarse buckets used by endpoint panels.
Devon: Immediate fix: switch endpoint pctl calc to merge_tdigest while we evaluate histogram binning. I'll push a feature-flag toggle.
ops-bot: config-change: dashboard-aggregation-toggle requested by Devon at 1734451242 (feature-flag:endpoint-tdigest=true)
Riley: Also add sample_count next to pctl on endpoint panels to make low-sample noise obvious.
Marta: Agreed. UX note: add a small badge "aggregation: histogram" or "aggregation: tdigest" on panels.
Devon: Hotfix applied to staging; staging endpoint p95 now matches raw ~88-92ms. Will canary to prod behind flag. ETA 15m.
ops-bot: deploy: dashboard-config updated (feature-flag:endpoint-tdigest=true) at 1734451250
Riley: After canary, values converged. Closing for now. Filing ENG-9077 to document tradeoffs + UI hints.
Marta: TL;DR: histograms save storage but can distort tails; surface merge semantics and sample counts in the UI.
